calculation.description: Cross-sectional 3-day reversal residualized by the daily median, continuously scaled by the prior completed day's five-day gold-minus-US10Y return spread. Positive defensive spread increases reversal exposure; negative spread reverses/scales it down. All inputs are lagged or available through the decision date.

validation.regime_notes: Recent online-period validation passes both benchmark gates (absolute IC >= 0.007 and absolute ICIR >= 0.084). Earlier dates were excluded because the factor artifact is intentionally evaluated only from online start and the defensive lead-lag design requires aligned history. Interpret uncertainty conservatively given 153 dates and a 15-asset cross-section.
